title: Sounds (audio engine)
summary: The audio engine: one-shot SFX by SoundID, the cue map (moment -> sound) and gains as data, music player.
description: AudioEngine (AVAudioEngine voices), SoundBank (the Sounds/<id>.wav files), AudioCues (Tuning/audio.json `cues` / `gain` into typed tables), MusicPlayer (music bus, off by default). Our sounds are synthesised by apps/mazeout/tools/audio (never recorded from another game). SoundBoard is the debug host.
gaps: The cue key `cues.arrowTap` is the reference puzzle's name; a generic move cue is open (docs/ROADMAP.md).
